idea.text:
A confident number
tells you how sure to be.
idea.trig: tells you how sure to be
idea.rep: has to be checked against what happened

turn.cmd: Quiz me on the terms for judging a confident number. Give me one short case at a time. I must name the exact term, choosing from base rate, sensitivity, PPV, which is positive predictive value, calibration, overconfidence, decorative number, independence, the multiplication rule, distribution shift and heavy-tailed. I must also say why its look-alike is wrong. Hold back the answer until I reply, then correct me briefly.
